owner_decision.decision: Approve the anchor proposal: RFC 3161 (FreeTSA + DigiCert) plus OpenTimestamps, S3 Object Lock, VPS host
owner_decision.scope: DESIGN APPROVAL ONLY. Not capture activation, not admission activation, not forward validation, not eligibility.

activation.note: Each flag requires a separate owner ruling after VPS, bucket, pinned CA bundles, CI wiring and independent review.

tsa_providers.policy_provenance: t130: TSTInfo policy OID and DER sha256 of the [0] tsa GeneralName, parsed from the real recorded t127 fixture token (tests/fixtures/anchor/tsa_fixture_t127.json).
tsa_providers.pin_procedure: Download cacert.pem and tsa.crt from freetsa.org over two independent networks, compare, commit to config/anchors/freetsa_ca.pem, record DER sha256 of tsa.crt here, set status=pinned. Owner/ChatGPT step.

tsa_providers.blocked_reason: t127: no real DigiCert RFC 3161 token could be recorded from the build host (timestamp.digicert.com is HTTP-only; outbound port 80 times out, HTTPS refused), so the signer cert cannot be taken from a real token. Root G4 cross-checked in the provenance doc; provider stays unpinned.
tsa_providers.pin_procedure: Obtain DigiCert Assured ID / Trusted Root G4 and the current timestamping intermediate from DigiCert's published repository; take signer cert from a real token; commit bundle to config/anchors/digicert_ca.pem, record DER sha256, set status=pinned. Owner/ChatGPT step.

nonce_ledger.note: t130: append-only, flock-serialised, single-use nonces; recorded at request time; ledger errors refuse admission. Must live on the capture host's persistent disk.

ots.role: secondary long-run proof; never gates admission
